source_work.title: Designing Finite State Machines with GPT-4

first_source_policy: assets/raw only stores first-source code archived from the author GitHub repository at the pinned commit; extracted/ stores direct audit records from running unmodified source code through an OpenAI-compatible proxy. No historical repo parquet/cache is used.

assets.notes: Git archive of the author repository at pinned commit. Source code is kept unchanged; .env files in the repository are placeholder comments only.

derived_assets.derivation_method: Run err_lim/model.py::generate_text from an unmodified checkout with OPENAI_BASE_URL pointing to a local OpenAI-compatible proxy backed by .env LLM_MODEL=gpt-5.5.
derived_assets.notes: Only demonstrates the initial NL->CSV generation call path. It does not create a frozen first-source NL+STM seed pair and does not complete all repair/oracle pipelines.

derived_assets.derivation_method: Output copied from the successful connectivity check record.
derived_assets.notes: Small synthetic Mealy example output, not an author-published dataset row.

skipped_assets.reason: These are run artifacts in the repository, not a versioned first-source generated pair package for this paper; they are not counted as final_pool_ready seed data.
